build_parlai_wrapper: use parlai_wrapper_factory to load a ParlAI wrapper for a Diplomacy model config
load_order_wrapper: use load_order_wrapper to load a BaseOrderWrapper from a ParlAI model config
load_dialogue_wrapper: use load_dialogue_wrapper to load a BaseDialogueWrapper from a ParlAI model config
load_nonsense_classifier: use load_nonsense_classifier_wrapper to load a nonsense classifier wrapper from a config
load_ensemble_nonsense_classifier: use load_ensemble_nonsense_classifier_wrapper to load an ensemble of nonsense classifiers across GPUs
